questions.stemHtml: The price of cooking oil rises by 25%. By what percentage must a family reduce its consumption of cooking oil so that its expenditure on cooking oil stays the same?
questions.solutionHtml:
Step 1: Expenditure = price × consumption. If the price becomes 5/4 of the original, consumption must become 4/5 of the original to keep expenditure unchanged.

Step 2: Reduction = 1 − 4/5 = 1/5 = 20%.

Shortcut: reduction % = r/(100 + r) × 100 = 25/125 × 100 = 20%. The trap answer 25% ignores that the cut is measured on the old (smaller) base.

questions.stemHtml: A shopkeeper sells two mobile phones for ₹1,200 each. On one he gains 20% and on the other he loses 20%. What is his overall result on the two sales?
questions.solutionHtml:
Step 1: Phone sold at a 20% gain: cost price = 1200 ÷ 1.2 = ₹1,000.

Step 2: Phone sold at a 20% loss: cost price = 1200 ÷ 0.8 = ₹1,500.

Step 3: Total cost = ₹2,500; total selling price = ₹2,400. Loss = ₹100.

Step 4: Loss % = 100/2500 × 100 = 4% loss.

Shortcut: When two equal selling prices carry a gain and a loss of the same x%, there is always a loss of x²/100 % = 400/100 = 4%.

questions.stemHtml: The difference between the compound interest (compounded annually) and the simple interest on a certain sum for 2 years at 12% per annum is ₹72. What is the sum?
questions.solutionHtml:
Step 1: For 2 years, CI − SI = P × (r/100)², because the only extra in CI is the interest earned in year 2 on year 1's interest.

Step 2: 72 = P × (0.12)² = 0.0144P.

Step 3: P = 72 ÷ 0.0144 = ₹5,000.

Check: SI = 5000 × 0.24 = 1200; CI = 5000 × (1.12² − 1) = 5000 × 0.2544 = 1272; difference = 72. ✓

questions.stemHtml: Asha can finish a piece of work in 12 days and Bhanu can finish it in 18 days. They work together for 4 days, after which Asha leaves and Bhanu completes the rest alone. In how many days in all is the work completed?
questions.solutionHtml:
Step 1: Take the total work as LCM(12, 18) = 36 units. Asha does 3 units/day, Bhanu 2 units/day.

Step 2: In 4 days together they do 4 × 5 = 20 units. Remaining work = 16 units.

Step 3: Bhanu alone needs 16 ÷ 2 = 8 days.

Step 4: Total time = 4 + 8 = 12 days. (Choosing 8 forgets the first 4 days.)

questions.stemHtml: A train 240 m long crosses a platform 360 m long in 30 seconds. How long will it take to pass a man who is walking at 18 km/h along the track in the same direction as the train?
questions.solutionHtml:
Step 1: To cross the platform the train covers 240 + 360 = 600 m in 30 s, so its speed = 20 m/s = 72 km/h.

Step 2: Same direction, so relative speed = 72 − 18 = 54 km/h = 54 × 5/18 = 15 m/s.

Step 3: To pass the man the train covers only its own length: time = 240 ÷ 15 = 16 seconds.

(12 s would come from ignoring the man's speed; adding the speeds would be wrong because they move in the same direction.)

questions.stemHtml: A 60-litre mixture contains milk and water in the ratio 7 : 3. How many litres of water must be added to make the ratio of milk to water 3 : 2?
questions.solutionHtml:
Step 1: Milk = 7/10 × 60 = 42 L; water = 18 L.

Step 2: Milk is unchanged, so we need 42/(18 + x) = 3/2, i.e. 18 + x = 28.

Step 3: x = 10 litres.

Check: 42 : 28 = 3 : 2. ✓

questions.stemHtml: The roots of the equation x² − 7x + k = 0 are real and differ by 3. What is the value of k?
questions.solutionHtml:
Step 1: Let the roots be α and β. Sum α + β = 7 and difference α − β = 3.

Step 2: Solving, α = 5 and β = 2.

Step 3: k = product of roots = 5 × 2 = 10.

Alternative: (α − β)² = (α + β)² − 4αβ ⇒ 9 = 49 − 4k ⇒ k = 10.

questions.stemHtml: How many integers x satisfy the inequality |2x − 5| < 9?
questions.solutionHtml:
Step 1: |2x − 5| < 9 means −9 < 2x − 5 < 9.

Step 2: Adding 5: −4 < 2x < 14, so −2 < x < 7.

Step 3: The integers strictly between −2 and 7 are −1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, i.e. 8 integers.

(9 is the count if the strict inequality is wrongly treated as ≤ at one end; note x = −2 gives |−9| = 9, which is not less than 9.)

questions.stemHtml: In a right-angled triangle the two sides containing the right angle are 9 cm and 12 cm. What is the length of the perpendicular drawn from the right-angle vertex to the hypotenuse?
questions.solutionHtml:
Step 1: Hypotenuse = √(9² + 12²) = √225 = 15 cm.

Step 2: Area = ½ × 9 × 12 = 54 cm². The same area = ½ × 15 × h.

Step 3: h = 108 ÷ 15 = 7.2 cm.

questions.stemHtml: A solid metal cylinder of radius 6 cm and height 10 cm is melted and recast into solid cones, each of radius 3 cm and height 4 cm. Assuming no metal is lost, how many cones are obtained?
questions.solutionHtml:
Step 1: Volume of cylinder = π × 6² × 10 = 360π cm³.

Step 2: Volume of one cone = ⅓ × π × 3² × 4 = 12π cm³.

Step 3: Number of cones = 360π ÷ 12π = 30.

(Forgetting the ⅓ in the cone formula gives 10; the other options come from arithmetic slips with the radii.)

questions.stemHtml: What is the remainder when 745 is divided by 5?
questions.solutionHtml:
Step 1: The remainder on division by 5 depends only on the units digit. Units digits of powers of 7 repeat in the cycle 7, 9, 3, 1 (length 4).

Step 2: 45 = 4 × 11 + 1, so 745 has the same units digit as 71, i.e. 7.

Step 3: A number ending in 7 leaves remainder 2 when divided by 5.

questions.stemHtml: How many positive divisors (factors) does 720 have?
questions.solutionHtml:
Step 1: Prime factorise: 720 = 24 × 32 × 51.

Step 2: Number of divisors = (4 + 1)(2 + 1)(1 + 1) = 5 × 3 × 2 = 30.

questions.stemHtml: In how many distinct ways can the letters of the word MANAGER be arranged so that all the vowels always come together?
questions.solutionHtml:
Step 1: MANAGER has 7 letters: consonants M, N, G, R and vowels A, A, E.

Step 2: Tie the three vowels into one block. Units to arrange: M, N, G, R and [block] = 5 distinct units ⇒ 5! = 120 ways.

Step 3: Inside the block, A, A, E can be arranged in 3!/2! = 3 ways (the two A's are identical).

Step 4: Total = 120 × 3 = 360.

(720 forgets that the two A's are identical; 240 counts only 2 internal orders of the block instead of 3.)

questions.stemHtml: Two fair six-sided dice are thrown together. What is the probability that the sum of the numbers shown is a prime number?
questions.solutionHtml:
Step 1: Possible prime sums: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11.

Step 2: Number of outcomes: sum 2 → 1, sum 3 → 2, sum 5 → 4, sum 7 → 6, sum 11 → 2. Total = 15.

Step 3: Probability = 15/36 = 5/12.

questions.stemHtml: Which company recorded the highest percentage growth in sales from 2022 to 2024?
questions.solutionHtml:
Growth from 2022 to 2024:

  • Aster: 324/240 = 1.35 ⇒ 35%
  • Birch: 216/180 = 1.20 ⇒ 20%
  • Cedar: 336/300 = 1.12 ⇒ 12%
  • Delta: 207/150 = 1.38 ⇒ 38%
  • Elm: 252/210 = 1.20 ⇒ 20%

Highest: Delta (38%). Aster has the largest absolute increase (₹84 crore) but a smaller percentage increase.

questions.stemHtml: By approximately what percentage did the combined sales of all five companies in 2023 exceed their combined sales in 2022?
questions.solutionHtml:
Step 1: Total 2022 = 240 + 180 + 300 + 150 + 210 = ₹1,080 crore.

Step 2: Total 2023 = 270 + 225 + 285 + 180 + 252 = ₹1,212 crore.

Step 3: Increase = 132; percentage = 132/1080 × 100 ≈ 12.2%.

(10.8% is 132/1212, i.e. the change measured on the wrong base.)

questions.stemHtml: By how much (in ₹ crore) does the average annual sales of Cedar over the three years exceed the average annual sales of Birch over the same three years?
questions.solutionHtml:
Step 1: Cedar total = 300 + 285 + 336 = 921 ⇒ average = 307.

Step 2: Birch total = 180 + 225 + 216 = 621 ⇒ average = 207.

Step 3: Difference = 307 − 207 = ₹100 crore. (Equivalently, (921 − 621)/3 = 300/3 = 100.)

questions.stemHtml: Women make up approximately what percentage of the firm's total workforce?
questions.solutionHtml:
Step 1: Women in each department: HR 45% of 80 = 36; Finance 35% of 120 = 42; Marketing 40% of 150 = 60; Operations 20% of 250 = 50.

Step 2: Total women = 188; total employees = 80 + 120 + 150 + 250 = 600.

Step 3: 188/600 × 100 ≈ 31.3%.

(Simply averaging the four percentages gives 35%, which ignores that departments differ in size.)

questions.stemHtml: What is the average monthly salary of all the employees of the firm taken together (to the nearest rupee)?
questions.solutionHtml:
Step 1: Salary bill (₹ thousand): HR 80 × 52 = 4,160; Finance 120 × 68 = 8,160; Marketing 150 × 60 = 9,000; Operations 250 × 48 = 12,000.

Step 2: Total = 33,320 thousand for 600 employees.

Step 3: Average = 33,320/600 ≈ 55.533 thousand = ₹55,533.

(₹57,000 is the simple average of the four department averages, which wrongly gives the small HR department the same weight as Operations.)

questions.stemHtml: Suppose 20% of the men in Operations are transferred to Marketing and nothing else changes. What percentage of Marketing's employees will then be women (approximately)?
questions.solutionHtml:
Step 1: Men in Operations = 80% of 250 = 200. 20% of them = 40 men move to Marketing.

Step 2: Marketing now has 150 + 40 = 190 employees, of whom women are still 40% of 150 = 60.

Step 3: 60/190 × 100 ≈ 31.6%.

(Taking 20% of all 250 Operations employees, i.e. 50 people, would give 60/200 = 30%, not listed; 33.3% comes from using 180 as the new size.)
